podcast.title: Depeche Mode Riot Incident (March 20, 1990)
podcast.body: One of The Warehouse's stores in Los Angeles was the site of an infamous riot on March 20, 1990, during an autograph session for Depeche Mode's *Violator* album. Thousands of fans overwhelmed security, prompting a "tactical alert" by the LAPD and the deployment of 20 police units. The chaotic event led to injuries, arrests, and damage, including to a Fox News microwave van, and forced the band to depart early. "One of their stores in Los Angeles was the scene of the infamous Depeche Mode riot during an autograph session for the violator Ravel on March 20th 1990."

podcast.title: Victim of Mass Extinction
podcast.body: Warehouse was mentioned as one of the many big chain record stores that became defunct as physical media sales declined and online music access grew. "Music world, warehouse, blockbuster music, Kamalot, coconuts, peaches, and a whole bunch more."
